title: Model Hub — quickpin onboarding storyboard + UX copy (draft)
content:
Summary:
This is a working draft for the Model Hub "quickpin" onboarding flow — a lightweight funnel to let engineers discover a model variant, create an endpoint, and optionally pin a specific model version with clear defaults and guardrails. Goal: reduce time-to-first-endpoint for new users, make pinning explicit and low-friction, and avoid accidental hard-pinning that blocks rollouts.

Audience / Personas:
- Platform engineer (wants predictability for production endpoints)
- Product engineer (wants fastest time-to-test with minimal config)
- Solutions engineer (onboarding customer, needs safe defaults)

Success metrics (initial experiments):
- Increase new-endpoint creation conversion from Model Hub -> Endpoint created by 2x in first two weeks
- % of pinned endpoints created with explicit pin confirmation > 95% (reduce accidental pins)
- Time from model selection to first request < 6 minutes (including onboarding copy & defaults)

Flow overview (micro-frames for storyboard):
Frame A: Model Hub list (landing)
- Visual: cards for model families with key attributes (size, expected latency, recommended tasks).
- Copy snippets: Title: "Choose a model for your endpoint"; Subtext: "See recommended variants for common tasks and estimated tail latency."
- Primary CTA on card: "Try variant" (opens variant drawer)

Frame B: Variant drawer (quick inspect)
- Visual: left column: model metadata + perf badges; right column: quick actions (Try locally, Create endpoint, Compare).
- Microcopy: "Variant: gptx-7b-q4 (recommended)"; Badge tooltips: "~20ms median at 512 tokens on rtx-a6000"
- Buttons: Primary: "Create endpoint"; Secondary: "Try in playground"

Frame C: Create endpoint modal (defaults-first)
- Fields presented in order: Endpoint name (auto-suggest), Region (auto), Capacity tier (default: dev), Pin model version (toggle, default: off).
- Inline helper: "Recommended: leave pin off for automatic model updates unless you need strict reproducibility. Pinning creates a checkpoint and requires explicit version bump for upgrades."
- Copy for pin toggle when off: "Pin to a specific version (recommended for regulated workloads)"
- When user toggles pin ON -> reveal version selector (latest stable selected by default) + a short warning microcopy below:
  - Warning title: "Pinning locks model version for this endpoint"
  - Warning body: "Pinned endpoints won't receive automatic improvements. Use pinning for reproducibility or when you want to control upgrades. To roll forward later, use 'Pin management' from the endpoint page."
- Primary CTA: "Create endpoint" (small spinner + success toast)

Frame D: Pin confirmation step (inline, small modal)
- Purpose: prevent accidental pins and capture reason for pinning for audit and rollout hints.
- Copy: "Confirm pin: gptx-7b-q4 v2025-02-12"
- Inputs: Short freeform reason (optional) with placeholder: "Why pin this endpoint? e.g. regression in v2025-02-18"
- Buttons: "Confirm and create endpoint" (primary) and "Choose automatic updates instead" (secondary).

Microcopy & strings (canonical naming recommendations):
- Endpoint name placeholder: "my-replies-endpoint"
- Region default label: "Auto-select (closest region)"
- Capacity tiers: "dev", "standard", "dedicated" (tooltip: "dev is bursty and best for testing")
- Pin toggle: Off label: "Allow automatic updates"; On label: "Pin to version"
- Small success toast: "Endpoint created · 15s warmup to first token"
- Info pill on endpoint page after pin: "Pinned: gptx-7b-q4 v2025-02-12 · Last validated: 2025-02-20"

Error states & edge cases (copy + UX behavior):
- If user pins a version that is incompatible with region/hardware: show inline error: "Selected version not available in us-west-2 on this capacity tier. Choose a different tier or region."
- If user attempts pin without permission: "You don’t have permission to pin models. Contact your admin or request the `endpoint.pin` role." (link to RBAC docs)
- If creation fails due to capacity constraints: "Creation delayed — queued for provisioning. We'll notify you and retry automatically." (CTA: "View provisioning queue")

Observability & onboarding hints (post-create UX):
- First-time tip (tooltip on endpoint page): "Tip: Pinning preserves exact behavior. Use 'Check performance' and 'Run diff' to verify before switchover."
- Quick links on success screen: "Open test playground"; "View pin management"; "Add to team config"

Backlog grooming notes (priority order):
- PROD-621 (3): Implement variant drawer UI + perf badges (depends: perf metadata API)
- PROD-622 (5): Create endpoint modal + pin toggle behavior + audit events (backend + event log)
- PROD-623 (2): Pin confirmation mini-modal + reason field (frontend + small audit schema)
- PROD-645 (1): Toasts and success flows + first-time user tip content
- UX spike: Rethink default state for pin toggle across teams (platform vs prod) — research 1 week

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- Users can create an endpoint from Model Hub in < 6 clicks and < 6 minutes
- Pin toggle default is OFF; turning on requires explicit confirmation modal
- Pin reasons are persisted to audit log and visible on endpoint details (readable by owners)
- Incompatible pin choices surface clear, actionable errors

Open questions / decisions required:
- Should org-level policy override the default (e.g., orgs that must pin by default for compliance)? Proposal: expose an org-level toggle (admin console) that flips the default for all users.
- How many historical pinned versions to surface in the inline selector? Minimal suggestion: last 10 stable releases.
- Recording reason field — optional vs required? Recommendation: make optional but encourage via microcopy; require for orgs with compliance tag.

Implementation notes for eng partners (short):
- Backend: endpoint create API should accept pin_mode: [auto, pinned] + pinned_version (optional) + pin_reason (optional). Emit audit event with actor, timestamp, reason.
- Frontend: lazy-load perf badges and variant metadata to keep hub list snappy. Drawer should be dismissible with escape.
- Telemetry: track metric: model_hub -> create_endpoint conversion, pin_toggle_used, pin_confirmed (with reason).

Testing / validation plan:
- QA checklist: confirm UI flows for pin off/on, error displays for region incompat, verify audit log entries
- Beta cohort: 10 internal teams, monitor time-to-first-request and pin rollback support feedback

Copy alternatives (short list to A/B test):
- Pin toggle helper variant A: "Keep this exact model version for reproducible results."
- Variant B: "Lock this endpoint to a specific model snapshot — you’ll manage upgrades manually."
- Confirmation CTA A: "Confirm and create endpoint"; CTA B: "Pin and launch"

Notes to reviewers:
- This doc is intentionally lightweight — aiming for a fast user flow and clear defaults. Please comment on any phrasing that sounds too heavy (especially warnings).
- Liaise with security for the org-default-pin policy edge-case.

Changelog (timeline):
- 2025-02-15: initial draft and storyboard (Sofia)
- 2025-02-20: added backend payload proposal and backlog (Liam)
- 2025-02-27: copy alternatives and A/B test suggestions (Priya)
- 2025-03-01: incorporated SRE feedback about region compatibility error messaging (Marco)
